meta.name: ulw-plan
meta.description: ACTIVATES ONLY on an explicit user request for the ulw-plan workflow: the user themselves saying ulw-plan, ulw plan, /skill:ulw-plan, or asking in their own words for a work plan before coding. NEVER self-activates: a bare ulw/ultrawork run, an agent-side routing decision, or reading this file is not a request, and the plan-gated reviewers (metis/momus) stay locked without a user request plus a written .omo/plans plan file. Explore-first planning consultant (Prometheus) that grounds in the codebase, asks only the forks exploration cannot resolve - or researches them to best practice when the intent is fuzzy - waits for explicit approval, then writes ONE decision-complete work plan a worker executes with zero further interview. Triggers: ulw-plan, ulw plan, plan this, make a plan, plan before coding, interview me, break this down, start planning, plan mode.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把开发任务拆成可直接执行的工作计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你习惯先规划再动手写代码
copy.tagline_en: Break down development tasks into an executable work plan
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you prefer planning before writing code

howto.what: 它先只读探索项目,把大需求整理成一份写清步骤和细节的工作计划,执行者照着做就行;未获你同意不会写出计划,并且从不改代码。
howto.when: 只有当你明确要求先做计划再写代码时才触发,比如说出“ulw-plan”“plan this”或“帮我做个计划”。平时普通对话或让它直接写代码时不会激活。

say.text: ulw-plan,先给登录接口的限流做个计划。
say.note: Claude会先探索再写计划,不改代码。

say.text: plan this:帮我梳理一下用户注册流程,写份计划。
say.note: 只产出计划文档,不会直接改代码。

say.text: 先别写代码,把这个重构任务拆成可执行步骤。
say.note: 它会先探索,并在你确认前不写计划。

howto.what_en: Turns Claude into a planning consultant: it only reads and searches, turns a vague/large request into one detailed written plan a worker can follow directly, requires your explicit okay before writing it, and never edits code.
howto.when_en: Activates only when you explicitly ask for a plan before coding, e.g. by saying "ulw-plan", "plan this", or asking in your own words. It never self-activates and does not handle ordinary coding requests.

say_en.text: ulw-plan, make a plan for rate-limiting the login endpoint.
say_en.note: No code changes; explores first, then writes the plan.

say_en.text: plan this: outline the user registration flow for me.
say_en.note: It only produces a plan document; no code changes yet.

say_en.text: Don't code yet - break this refactor into executable steps.
say_en.note: Explores first, then waits for your approval before writing.
